sources.note: Read the full hybrid+electric under-$10k list live (24 cards within 100 mi, price asc). New/changed vs 8/07: a cheaper lower-mileage 2011 Ford Fusion Hybrid ($6,794/91,747, Colorado Springs, Great Deal) is now the headline Fusion; 2016 Kia Optima Hybrid Base added ($7,599/142,995, Denver, Good Deal); 2013 Ford C-Max Hybrid ticked UP to $7,258 (was $6,974); a very-low-mileage 2013 Nissan Leaf S ($8,045/29,864, Loveland) and 2015 Leaf S ($9,633/21,764, Loveland) appear. The efficient-gas half of the all-fuel list was checked but the cheap results are trucks/large SUVs; no pure-gas car beat the hybrids on value this run.

Loaded the 80015 all-fuel price-asc list live (3,557 vehicles). The cheapest results are sponsored non-efficient trucks/SUVs (Buick Enclave 19 mpg, Ford Explorer 15 mpg, Chevy Suburban, Jeep Liberty). The in-radius hybrids/EVs overlap the Cars.com set already captured with the same deal ratings; no unique in-radius listing beat the Cars.com/private picks.

Searched prius live (188 results, heavy dealer keyword-spam from Done Deal/Pammi/One Stop). Real private/relevant reconfirmed: 2022 Prius Prime PHEV $8,950/62k (4301 Morrison Rd dealer), 2014 Prius Two $7,550/145k N Denver, 2010 Prius $8,700/108k Denver, 2014 Prius Plug-in $9,900/107k Lakewood. NEW: 2012 Prius v $8,600/135k Denver and a 2015 Chevrolet Volt $9,499/107k (One Stop Motors).

Logged in. Searched prius (few results: 2006/2007 Priuses) and hybrid (scrolled multiple screens). Confirmed live: NEW 2012 Hyundai Sonata Hybrid SE $5,500 Denver, NEW 2010 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE $5,950 Englewood, and 2008 Toyota Camry Hybrid LE $5,999 Denver. The 8/07 FB Avalon Hybrid and 2016 Sonata Hybrid did NOT resurface this run (FB listings are ephemeral) so they were dropped. FB photos are signed/ephemeral - left null.
Hybrid inventory loads (2,088 cars) but the price=0-10000 filter is ignored - the cheapest tier is 'Under $20,000' and every car shown is $22k+. No sub-$10k stock.

Read the Motors BIN prius search live (19 results). Nearly all are nationwide with generic 'delivery or pickup available'; several are rebuilder/project cars. Only one showed a real local distance (2014 Prius $8,500/156k, free pickup 22 mi from 80015) and it did not beat the local Prius deals.

Searched prius live (mileage on tiles). Reconfirmed: 2008 Prius $4,299/121k Denver, 2016 Prius c $7,500/100k Aurora. A 2012 Prius v $8,999/146k Denver appears (same car as the Craigslist $8,600 Prius v - collapsed to one entry).
The used-cars-denver price search URL returned an HTTP 404 page again this run. Hertz Car Sales fleet is late-model (2020+) with no sub-$10k hybrids/EVs near 80015.

Both the search.html location URL and the /list/used-cars path returned Enterprise's 404 page again this run (re-attempted live with two URL layouts). Their own price tiers start at 'Under $20k' - no sub-$10k hybrids/EVs in fleet inventory.
Utah-only; well beyond the 100-mi radius of 80015. Not stretching the radius this run - the local market has ample supply.

listings.carSeatNotes: Modern Prius liftback - roomy rear seat with top-tether and LATCH; rear-facing fits well and the big hatch swallows a stroller and daycare bags.
listings.nextAction: Dealer (4301 Morrison Rd) - request the Carfax; confirm it is the plug-in Prime (~25 mi EV range) and that the ~62k miles match service records.
listings.why: By far the newest, safest and most efficient car on the list: a 2022 plug-in with ~25 mi electric range that covers the daily ~25 mi commute on the home L1 outlet, then 54 mpg on gas. 5-star NHTSA, 0 open recalls. Reconfirmed live at $8,950/62k this run.
